name: Kyouhaku 2 ~Kizu ni Saku Hana Senketsu no Aka~
original_name: 脅迫2 ～傷に咲く花 鮮血の紅～
source:
Saki Akehime is a beautiful girl who has an English mother. She has a secret. She is going out with her teacher, Akito Tsuge, and holding such an immoral secret makes her excited. However there is a figure looking at their acts. One day, Saki receives a phone. Although she is suspicious about the phone, she goes out with Akito not knowing there is a trap full of shame waiting for her...

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=7518]ANN[/url]]
translation:
明姬咲是一名母亲来自英国的美少女。她藏着一个秘密：自己正在与教师柘植彰人交往，而背负这种不道德的秘密令她兴奋不已。可是，有一道身影正窥视他们的一举一动。某天，咲接到一通电话。尽管心存疑虑，她仍和彰人一同赴约，丝毫不知道充满屈辱的陷阱正在等待自己……

[译自 [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=7518]ANN[/url]]
